sentences.en: He is second to none when it comes to debating.
Some companies are still debating whether to get Internet access.
sentences.zh: 有些公司在是否接入互联网一事上还在犹豫。

sentences.en: The two teams debated on the issue of nuclear power.
sentences.zh: 两队就核能问题展开了讨论。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：de（加强）+bat（打）+e →是否加大打击力度，大家争论不休→争论，辩论
